name: B10-0410/2025 (ESN) – Declaration of principles for a gender-equal society
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the declaration of principles for a gender-equal society
part_text:
This text is a proposed statement of principles, not a change in law. It says men and women are equal before the law, but that biological differences between them should be respected in areas like sport, safety, healthcare and education. It says equality means fair opportunity, not forced equal outcomes or quotas. It also says parents, not the state, have the main responsibility for raising and educating children, and it calls on the European Commission to respect national powers and cultural diversity when making equality policy.

- It asks the Commission to keep equality policy within national powers; no law changes yet.
- It affects parents, women, men and national governments across the EU.
- Next, the Parliament votes on whether to adopt this statement.
